summary: Frontend-only mobile web regression run completed against the latest contact-name, call layout, ringtone, and composer updates. App boot, chat route, disappearing-options interaction, and call route remained runtime-stable in unauthenticated preview; however, real-contact assertions (including 'Asare Ben Chris') were blocked by auth-gated data access.

ui_bugs.issue: On 375x667 viewport, call subtitle text ('Voice Call' / 'Connecting…') visually collides with top control row region, indicating vertical spacing remains tight and can overlap call actions.

integration_issues.flow: Real contact conversation open (e.g., 'Asare Ben Chris')
integration_issues.issue: Could not validate due auth-gated production data in automation. Signed-in real-contact flow is required to confirm crash fix and display-name parity.
Could not verify audible ringtone preference behavior in web preview automation; requires signed-in native/device validation during real outgoing ring state.

issues: Call status/substatus typography stack is still too close to controls on compact mobile viewport, reducing readability and risking overlap with action controls.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist (expo-notifications web listener limitation, expo-av deprecation, shadow/textShadow/pointerEvents deprecation warnings).

action_items: Run authenticated end-to-end validation with real production contacts to confirm: no crash for 'Asare Ben Chris' and saved display names replacing generic fallback in chats/call headers.
Rework vertical spacing/font stack on voice call non-video screen for compact mobile heights so status text cannot overlap control rows.
Perform native-device outgoing-call test to confirm selected ringtone preference is heard while dialing.
critical_code_review_comments: Display-name resolver currently depends on conversation payload fields; if backend omits real contact alias fields, UI can still fall back to generic labels. Authenticated real-data verification is mandatory.
/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx and /app/frontend/app/call/[conversationId].tsx remain very large, increasing regression risk for layout and interaction changes.
Disappearing-message selection no longer crashed in this run (previous `writeStoredJson` error was not reproduced).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core unauthenticated route stability is good: /chat/test-conversation and /call/testconversation1 did not crash, and disappearing option tap was stable. Remaining validation requires a signed-in account with real contacts/conversations to confirm the five user-reported production issues.
rca_of_issue: Observed call-screen layout regression on compact viewport: status/substatus text stack and action controls occupy overlapping vertical region under current spacing and text sizes. Repro: open /call/testconversation1?type=voice at 375x667 and inspect the center/bottom area where 'Voice Call' and 'Connecting…' intersect control row zone.
